item.description:
Release v5.2.1

Changes since v5.2.0

  • feat(AppCommands): support top-level menus via AppKit bridge
  • feat(CommandPlugin): register Debug Commands in top-level menu
  • feat(ConversationStorePlugin, MessageStorePlugin): add status bar hover container for migration progress
  • feat(ConversationTitle): unify conversation title display via kernel.uiTitle
  • feat(LLMProviderMiniMaxPlugin): migrate HTTPClient to NetworkProviding
  • feat(LumiKernel): add NetworkProviding protocol for HTTP requests
  • feat(LumiKernel): generate default title when no custom title exists
  • feat(network): add streaming support to NetworkProviding and LLMAPIService
  • feat(NetworkManagerPlugin): add streaming support and HTTP exchange recording
  • feat(NetworkManagerPlugin): implement NetworkProviding for kernel
  • feat(NetworkManagerPlugin): split HTTP exchange detail into Request/Response tabs
  • feat(RAGPlugin): add lifecycle task tracking for background indexing
  • feat(ToolManagerPlugin): add streaming file reader and comprehensive tests
  • fix(ConversationStorePlugin): update updatedAt when conversation title changes
  • perf(RAGPlugin): add Task.checkCancellation() at key operation points
  • perf(RAGPlugin): cap candidate limits and cache entries to reduce memory usage
  • refactor(ConversationStorePlugin): store migration state in database directory instead of UserDefaults
  • refactor(EditorSwiftPlugin): migrate to pluginDataDirectory from Storage service
  • refactor(LLMProvider): pass kernel-based apiService to all providers
  • refactor(MessageStorePlugin): store migration state in database directory instead of UserDefaults
